title: ProgramDetail loadProgram silently swallows load errors with .catch(() => setLoading(false))
detail:
Line 46: `.catch(() => setLoading(false))` â€” no error state, no toast. On failure, loading spinner turns off and the page shows `

Program not found.

` at line 86, which is indistinguishable from a real 404. Same anti-pattern as ContractList CR-0251.
recommendedFix: Add `const [error, setError] = useState(null);` and distinguish load failure from not-found. Show a toast or error banner on load failure.
